lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white segments traverse the lateral torso. Spacing is approximately equidistant across the mid-section, with higher density observed toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcations are visible at the dorsal terminals of the 4th and 5th lines (counting from posterior), where segments merge into a single ridge point. A Y-shaped split is also present at the ventral end of the 8th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three abbreviated dashed segments are present: one located between the 1st and 2nd primary stripes on the upper haunch, and two shorter segments positioned on the mid-shoulder region that do not reach the spinal crest.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized grouping of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch, clustered in a triangular formation.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lateral upper thigh align on a horizontal axis, mimicking a truncated segment of the vertical line pattern.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The visible horn displays a lyrate curvature, projecting upward and slightly posterior at an approximate 70-degree angle from the frontal bone.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tip constitutes approximately 18% of the total visible vertical length of the right horn.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced chromatic transition between the dark-grey upper limb and the ochre/tan lower leg, beginning abruptly at the hock and carpal joints. A single white spot is visible on the lower facial plane near the muzzle.
